summary.business_type: Personal portfolio / personal brand (AI engineer, UAE)
summary.context: Repository first commit and site launch: 2026-08-24 (same day as the audit). Absence from the Google index is expected; the goal is a clean first indexation.
top_findings: No canonical URL: http/https x apex/www all return 200 with no redirect; a metadataBase bug (https://https//ahmadsaad.dev/) would corrupt a relative canonical
JSON-LD is an empty Organization stub instead of a populated Person/WebSite/ProfilePage graph with sameAs
~80% of proof-of-work content (4 role descriptions, 4 project captions) is unmounted from the DOM and invisible to crawlers and AI agents
AI-facing endpoints broken: template llms.txt/llms-full.txt from scripts/build-registry.mts shadow the route handlers, /me/craft.md returns 500, /me/experience.md is title-only
Mobile performance gated by one 174 KB JS chunk (~7 s throttled long task), TTFB 1.1-1.9 s with x-nextjs-cache MISS, 400 KB of eagerly preloaded oversized images, 3 dead analytics requests
robots.txt disallows /_next/ for all crawlers (merged User-agent: * groups), blocking CSS/JS/fonts for Googlebot
quick_wins: Cloudflare Always-Use-HTTPS + www->apex 301 redirect rule; fix metadataBase; add canonical; hardcode base URL
Paste the Person/WebSite/ProfilePage graph from findings/schema.md into app/page.tsx
Shorten the meta description to <=160 chars (rewrite in findings/content.md)
Delete buildLlmsFiles() from scripts/build-registry.mts, remove the Vercel analytics scripts, gate Umami on its env var, purge the Cloudflare cache for /llms*.txt

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Fully prerendered HTML (344 KB with content, no SPA dependency)
robots.txt references the sitemap; AI-training crawler policy already right-shaped

findings.title: No canonical + 4 duplicate URL variants (http/https x apex/www)
findings.description: All four variants return 200 with no redirect and no <link rel=canonical>; www's sitemap/robots self-report www URLs (host-derived in lib/server-url.ts). lib/seo/metadata.tsx builds metadataBase as new URL('https://https://ahmadsaad.dev/').
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare Always Use HTTPS + www->apex 301 rule (or middleware.ts); hardcode the base in lib/server-url.ts; metadataBase: new URL(productionUrl); alternates.canonical '/'.

findings.title: robots.txt disallows /_next/ for every crawler
findings.description: Cloudflare-managed and app-generated User-agent: * groups merge; hashed CSS/JS/font chunks under /_next/static/ are blocked for Googlebot.
findings.recommendation: Remove '/_next/' (and '/public/') from disallow in app/robots.ts.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are all absent on every response.
findings.recommendation: Add headers() in next.config.mjs or public/_headers; enable HSTS in Cloudflare.

findings.title: Hashed static assets not cached immutably
findings.description: /_next/static/*.css served with Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate.
findings.recommendation: Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for /_next/static/:path*.

findings.title: Dead analytics requests on every page load
findings.description: /stats/script.js (Umami, 404, NEXT_PUBLIC_UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID unset) plus /_vercel/insights/script.js and /_vercel/speed-insights/script.js on a Cloudflare deployment.
findings.recommendation: Remove the Vercel scripts; render the Umami <Script> only when the env var is set.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod changes on every request
findings.description: app/sitemap.ts uses dayjs() at request time; two fetches 3 s apart returned different lastmod values.
findings.recommendation: Use a manually bumped content date (code in findings/sitemap.md).

findings.title: og:image declared 1200x630 but the asset is 1600x836
findings.description: createMetadata hardcodes 1200x630; createOgImage generates w_1600,h_836.
findings.recommendation: Pass the real dimensions from createOgImage.

findings.title: HTML served with x-nextjs-cache: MISS on every fetch
findings.description: Observed on all fetches; lab TTFB 1.1-1.9 s.
findings.recommendation: Check the OpenNext ISR/cache configuration so the prerendered page is served from cache.

findings.title: Client-side collapse unmounts ~80% of proof-of-work content

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: LCP element is server-rendered text, so no image dependency

metrics_lab.sources: Lighthouse 13.4.1 (2 mobile runs, 4x CPU throttle; 1 desktop) + Playwright Chromium (4 runs, unthrottled). No CrUX field data; PSI API rate-limited without a key.
metrics_lab.lcp_element:
intro / role text

in 7 of 7 runs
metrics_lab.inp: not measurable in lab; TBT used as proxy

findings.title: One JS chunk blocks the main thread before the LCP text paints
findings.description: 224-b51a9b702c283363.js (174 KB) runs a single long task (~7 s at 4x throttle, 2.1 s desktop); mobile LCP 6-13 s, TBT up to 6.6 s. Compounded by the RevealOnLoad opacity animation on the intro.
findings.recommendation: Code-split heavy client components with next/dynamic({ssr:false}); render the hero visible by default; tighten browserslist to drop ~12 KB of polyfills.

findings.title: TTFB 1.1-1.9 s on every run with x-nextjs-cache: MISS
findings.description: The prerendered page appears to be rendered on the Worker per request; 0 ms edge RTT, so the delay is origin work.
findings.recommendation: Fix the OpenNext/Cloudflare cache so the HTML is served from cache; target TTFB < 0.8 s.

findings.title: 5 carousel JPEGs (400 KB, ~41% of page weight) eagerly preloaded and 30x oversized
findings.description: 5x <link rel=preload as=image>; ~347 KB wasted per Lighthouse; never the LCP element.
findings.recommendation: next/image with sizes/srcset and width/height; priority only on the active slide; lazy-load slides 2-5; drop the preloads.

findings.title: CLS 0.07-0.11 across runs
findings.description: Desktop culprit is the unsized carousel (0.097 of 0.106); mobile culprit is an accordion hydration race plus font swap.
findings.recommendation: Reserve space for the carousel and the collapsible panels; open the default-expanded panel server-side.

findings.title: No preconnect hints, 23 KB render-blocking CSS, Cloudflare Insights beacon ~0.66 s avoidable LCP delay
findings.description: Lighthouse critical-path audit.
findings.recommendation: Add preconnect for remaining third-party origins; defer the beacon; inline critical CSS.

findings.title: 3 dead analytics requests per load
findings.description: /stats/script.js (404), /_vercel/insights/script.js and /_vercel/speed-insights/script.js (wrong platform).
findings.recommendation: Remove the Vercel scripts; gate Umami on its env var.

findings.title: Hashed assets not cached immutably; 4 font preloads incl. one .otf
findings.description: Cache-Control max-age=0 on /_next/static; ~20 async JS chunks (309 KB) incl. motion + shooting-stars canvas.
findings.recommendation: Immutable cache rule for /_next/static/*; keep <= 2 font preloads; lazy-load decoration.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Training crawlers blocked while retrieval agents (Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) are allowed

findings.title: Template llms.txt / llms-full.txt shadow the real route handlers
findings.description: scripts/build-registry.mts writes public/llms.txt + llms-full.txt at build; the live llms.txt links 7 dead /craft/* URLs, a 500 (/me/craft.md) and a 404 (/me/bookmarks.md); llms-full.txt is 71 KB of template component code.
findings.recommendation: Remove buildLlmsFiles(); adopt the draft in findings/geo.md; purge the cache.

findings.title: /me/craft.md returns HTTP 500
findings.description: getAllPosts() reads MDX via fs.readdirSync at runtime on Workers.
findings.recommendation: Delete the route or make it truly static.

findings.title: Evidence passages hidden from agents
findings.description: Architecture / cost-governance / results text is in unmounted DOM.
findings.recommendation: See Content Quality (action 2.1).

findings.title: Weak entity signals
findings.description: No Person sameAs; name collision with saadahmad.dev and several public figures.
findings.recommendation: Schema fix + owned-profile links.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 5 images have descriptive alt text

findings.title: No width/height or srcset; not lazy-loaded; all preloaded
findings.description: Plain tags; /_next/image returns the original JPEG (optimizer inactive on Cloudflare).
findings.recommendation: next/image with sizes + a fixed aspect-ratio wrapper; preload only the first slide.

findings.title: JPEG only; WebP would save ~46% (386 -> ~209 KB)
findings.description: Per-file savings of 20-61%.
findings.recommendation: Pre-convert at build time or enable an image loader.

items: 1.1 One canonical URL: HTTPS + www->apex redirect, fix metadataBase, canonical tag, hardcode base URL
1.3 Person + WebSite + ProfilePage JSON-LD with sameAs
1.4 Search Console domain property, submit sitemap, static lastmod

phases.name: Phase 2: Make proof-of-work crawlable; fix what's broken
items: 2.1 Render collapsed role descriptions and all carousel captions in the DOM
2.2 Repair the llms.txt pipeline, experience.md, remove/fix craft.md (500), purge cache
2.3 Security headers (HSTS, XCTO, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, frame-ancestors)

2.4 Performance: code-split the 174 KB blocking chunk, un-gate the LCP text from the reveal animation, fix HTML cache MISS/TTFB, next/image + lazy, drop preloads, remove dead analytics scripts, immutable caching
2.5 aria-labels, tap targets, carousel arrows, og:image dimensions

items: 3.1 Technical-PM framing sentence; LocalAI description + live demo; resolve repo visibility; refresh isCurrentEmployer
3.2 Owned-profile links: GitHub website/homepage fields, LinkedIn website, chapter pages
3.3 Two architecture write-ups for earned mentions

Weekly GSC: indexed = 1, no duplicates, branded impressions
Monthly AI-assistant citation check + lab CWV
